Black Smooth End Stops, Pair, Acorn-BHNBI

Acorn's Barn Door Hardware Miscellaneous Parts, End Stops. This smooth end stop is ideal to use as part of our barn door kits or in other barn / home renovation projects. The end stop, is completed in a smooth iron style with a matte black powder coat finish, is durable and wear-resistant.

Features and Specifications of the Black Smooth End Stops:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Lifetime no rust warranty.

Sold as a Pair
